usage: Use ToggleGroup when you need to collect user input or allow users to make selections. This component provides a consistent interaction pattern that users will find familiar and accessible.

ToggleGroup should be used within forms or interactive interfaces where user data collection is required. Ensure proper labeling and validation feedback for accessibility. Avoid using this component for read-only or display-only content.
